title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00042 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 03:30: WOC. Closed SV and bled off pressure on cement unit and surface lines. Monitored pressure in XT cross from prod. Control room. Meanwhile flushed lines from cement unit. Performed maintenance on BOP. Prepared to change out wires on FWD PRS. Bled off pressure in XT cross from 100 bar to 55 bar at 02 00.
03:30 - 07:00: WOC continued performing maintenance on BOP and FWD PRS. Bled off pressure in XT cross from 100 bar to 56 bar at 03 45 bled off pressure in XT cross from 100 bar to 54 bar at 06 10
07:00 - 12:00: WOC continued maintenance on BOP and FWD PRS. Tested kill manifold to 20/310bar for 5/10min. Bled off pressure in XT cross from 97 bar to 55 bar at 10 40.
12:00 - 12:15: Performed TBT for pressure testing and inflow testing cement plug

13:30 - 13:45: Bled off pressure on well from 300 bar to 10 bar via closed drain.

WOC continued maintenance on BOP and FWD PRS. Tested kill manifold to 20/310bar for 5/10min. Bled off pressure in XT cross from 97 bar to 55 bar at 10 40.
Performed TBT for pressure testing and inflow testing cement plug

Closed HMV and bled off pressure between HMV and SV to closed drain. Opened SV and equalized above HMV. Opened HMV and pressure tested cement plug to 300bar 10min. Volume pumped 560 ltrs from 67 bar to 300 bar. Monitored pressure from production control room.
Bled off pressure on well from 300 bar to 10 bar via closed drain.

Performed 23 bar inflow test of cement plug for 20 min. Monitored pressure from production control room. Observed increasing trend. Pressure increased from 10 bar to 18 bar in 45 min bar/10min), slightly flattening. Consulted town, agreed to continue inflow testing. Bled off pressure in well from 18 bar to 10 bar via closed drain. Performed new inflow test of cement plug. Pressure increased from 10 to 20 bar in 1,5 hrs bar/10min), slightly flattening. Meanwhile pressure tested BOP. Continued maintenance on FWD PRS.
Performed new inflow test of cement plug for 3 hrs. Pressure increased from 10 bar to 27bar bar/10min). Meanwhile continued pressure testing BOP.
Bled down pressure in well to 10 bar and performed new inflow test of cement plug. Monitored pressure for 30 min. Pressure increased 0,7 bar 10min, flattening trend.

Pressured up well to 310 bar with cement unit. Pumped 715 ltrs from 13 bar to 310 bar. Bled off pressure in DHSV control line. Bled off pressure in well to 240 bar. DHPG indicated DHSV in closed position. Performed 70 bar low-pressure inflow test of DHSV for 30 min.
Bled down pressure in well to 10 bar. Performed 300 bar hi-pressure inflow test of DHSV for 30min.

Pressured up well to 310 bar with cement unit, pumped 207 ltr from 12 bar to 310 bar. Observed DHSV opened at 288 bar 150ltrs pumped). Applied 520 bar pressure on DHSV control line. Bled off well to 20 bar through closed drain. Bled off pressure in DHSV control line.
